meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 探索代码时会改用 smart_search、smart_outline、smart_unfold 三个工具，不再默认用 Read、Grep、Glob。它先给出文件和符号的结构地图，再按需展开所需函数的源码。
howto.when: 当你需要理解代码结构、查找函数或浏览代码库时触发；此时它接管默认的 Read、Grep、Glob 探索行为。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude explores code with smart_search, smart_outline and smart_unfold instead of Read, Grep and Glob. It first returns a structural map of files and symbols, then unfolds only the functions you need.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase; while active it replaces Claude's default Read, Grep and Glob exploration behavior.

say_en.text: Use smart_search to find shutdown in ./src
say_en.note: One call returns ranked symbols and file structure
Returns the file's function and class skeleton
